title: Signature Global clocks Rs 67 cr profit in Q2 vs loss yr ago, revenue rises over 2-fold - The Economic Times
text:
Signature Global Ltd has reported a consolidated net profit of Rs 66.90 crore for the quarter ending September, marking a significant turnaround from last year's net loss of Rs 46.86 crore. With total income soaring from Rs 372.51 crore to Rs 870.70 crore, the company's chairman highlighted a robust demand for quality housing and its strong financial health.
